title: How Piku's music was played in the old days
summary: Nelson says Piku's style was the same, but they never used a band, just two guitars in the backyard at parties.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: can you tell us anything about how when you played with Piku in the old days what the band was like? how did he play? was it a different style than now? or what do you think?

well it was different it was the same style you know but we didn't never use no band with Piku we would always get on a party you know get two guitars and get in the backyard drink beer and all that have fun I know they played in a band with them too we just have to get together with the guitar two friends of us Sunday we meet and we go in the yard and have fun
